Name: Replace Fairy with Sanrio
Author: 00DoubleZero
Description:
[u][i][b][size=6]Sanrio Fairy Replace —— Cinnamoroll · Kuromi · Hello Kitty · My Melody
[/size][/b][/i][/u]Replaces the Stardew Valley Fairy with 4 cute Sanrio characters: Cinnamoroll, Kuromi, Hello Kitty, My Melody. Switch anytime via GMCM config menu.
[u][i][b]Requirements
[/b][/i][/u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI
[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher 
[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM (Generic Mod Config Menu)[/url]﻿
[u][i][b]How to Use
[/b][/i][/u]Install, launch the game, go to Mod Settings > GMCM, pick your favorite Sanrio character to replace the fairy.
AuthorRedbook @零零
[u][i][b][size=6]三丽鸥仙女替换 —— 玉桂狗・库洛米・凯蒂猫・美乐蒂
[/size][/b][/i][/u]把星露谷的仙女替换成超可爱的三丽鸥角色！
支持 4 种选择：玉桂狗、库洛米、凯蒂猫、美乐蒂，可在 GMCM 菜单里随意切换。
[b][i][u]前置要求
[/u][/i][/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM (Generic Mod Config Menu)[/url]﻿
[i][u][b]使用说明
[/b][/u][/i]安装后进入游戏，打开模组设置（GMCM），选择你最爱的三丽鸥角色即可替换仙女。
小红书：@零零（欢迎关注～）
